subject.title: improve(diagnostics): surface run startup phases as session-correlated events

question: Should embedded-runner execution phases become a supported public `DiagnosticEventPayload` and plugin SDK contract?
rationale: The implementation is technically sound, but only maintainers can accept the long-term compatibility commitment of evolving a public discriminated union consumed by external plugins.

options.title: Approve the public event
options.body: Accept `run.execution_phase` as an additive public contract, refresh the branch on current main, and merge with the documented non-exhaustive consumer guidance.

options.title: Keep phases internal
options.body: Do not expand the plugin SDK union and retain execution phases only for internal status, watchdog, or control surfaces.

options.title: Defer the API
options.body: Pause the PR until a broader versioned or open-ended diagnostic event contract is designed for external consumers.

recommendation.title: Approve the public event
recommendation.body: Accept `run.execution_phase` as an additive public contract, refresh the branch on current main, and merge with the documented non-exhaustive consumer guidance.
